description: Changes a claimed site: title (editors too); Site Owner: workspace (private site in, or "new"); name, a new address (a-z 0-9 hyphens, 8-63 chars on Free, 5-63 paid; approve_url; old one reclaimable 7 days); sender_name (≤40; "" clears); ai_invites (true: approve_url); archived true (two steps) takes it offline, false puts it back online (instead: one to freeze); notifications; analytics; search

ai_invites.description: Whether an AI may invite people (default on; each invite needs the owner's approval)

analytics.description: Click counting (clicks), kinds on or off (contact = phone, email and messaging), labels {event key or name: display name, null removes}, hidden (replaces the list)

instead.description: With archived false on a frozen site: a live site to freeze in its place

notifications.description: The caller's own emails: per category auto (as they come), daily (one summary) or off, or {email, in_app}; health = site alerts: down/up, traffic drop (auto or off); domain_live/domain_reminder (Site Owner); product_news (opt-in); scope site (this site) or all (default)

search.description: Search: ai_training, ai_answers (robots.txt requests; default allow), primary_domain (main custom domain; null: first connected), domain_redirect (default false), review_url, steps (Get found ticks)

title.description: The title shown in the app (1-120 chars; null: the page <title>)

workspace.description: Move a private site into this workspace (id or name from get_account), or "new"

name: site_settings
title: Change site settings
